__drizzle_migrations.schema:
CREATE TABLE "__drizzle_migrations" (
				id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
				hash text NOT NULL,
				created_at numeric
			)

enterprise.schema:
CREATE TABLE `enterprise` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`uscc_norm` text,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`name_norm` text NOT NULL,
	`district` text,
	`city` text,
	`reg_status` text,
	`quality_flags` text DEFAULT '[]'
)

record_event.schema:
CREATE TABLE `record_event` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`record_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`event_type` text NOT NULL,
	`year` integer,
	`batch_seq` integer,
	`sort_key` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, `review_outcome` text, `decided_year` integer,
	FOREIGN KEY (`record_id`) REFERENCES `record`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

record_evidence.schema:
CREATE TABLE `record_evidence` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`record_event_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`source_file` text NOT NULL,
	`attachment` text,
	`list_no` integer, `page` integer,
	FOREIGN KEY (`record_event_id`) REFERENCES `record_event`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

title.schema:
CREATE TABLE `title` (
	`code` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`name_zh` text NOT NULL,
	`level` text NOT NULL,
	`rank` integer NOT NULL
)

reconciliation_result.schema:
CREATE TABLE "reconciliation_result" (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`title_code` text NOT NULL,
	`enterprise_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`direction` text NOT NULL,
	`curated` integer DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	`evidence` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`title_code`) REFERENCES `title`(`code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`enterprise_id`) REFERENCES `enterprise`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

record.schema:
CREATE TABLE "record" (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`enterprise_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`title_code` text NOT NULL,
	`source` text NOT NULL,
	`district` text,
	`uscc_raw` text,
	`name_raw` text,
	`quality_flags` text DEFAULT '[]',
	FOREIGN KEY (`enterprise_id`) REFERENCES `enterprise`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`title_code`) REFERENCES `title`(`code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

source_document.schema:
CREATE TABLE "source_document" (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`source` text NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`doc_number` text,
	`issue_date` text,
	`path` text NOT NULL
)

stored_file.schema:
CREATE TABLE `stored_file` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`rel_path` text NOT NULL,
	`filename` text NOT NULL,
	`ext` text NOT NULL,
	`bytes` integer NOT NULL,
	`sha256` text NOT NULL,
	`source` text,
	`kind` text,
	`year` integer,
	`batch` integer,
	`title_code` text,
	`category_state` text DEFAULT 'unset' NOT NULL,
	`parse_state` text DEFAULT 'unparsed' NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`removed_at` text, `display_name` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`title_code`) REFERENCES `title`(`code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

stored_file_part.schema:
CREATE TABLE `stored_file_part` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`file_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`title_code` text NOT NULL,
	`event_kind` text NOT NULL,
	`year` integer,
	`batch` integer,
	`attachment` text,
	`row_count` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, `origin` text DEFAULT 'derived' NOT NULL, `has_conflict` integer DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`file_id`) REFERENCES `stored_file`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`title_code`) REFERENCES `title`(`code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

job.schema:
CREATE TABLE `job` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`kind` text NOT NULL,
	`params` text NOT NULL,
	`state` text DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL,
	`progress` text DEFAULT '{"done":0,"total":1}' NOT NULL,
	`result` text,
	`error` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`started_at` text,
	`finished_at` text
)

ocr_result.schema:
CREATE TABLE `ocr_result` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`file_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`page_no` integer NOT NULL,
	`page_rel_path` text,
	`markdown` text NOT NULL,
	`raw` text,
	`engine` text DEFAULT 'paddleocr' NOT NULL,
	`model` text,
	`channel` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`file_id`) REFERENCES `stored_file`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

difference_reason.schema:
CREATE TABLE `difference_reason` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`enterprise_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`title_code` text NOT NULL,
	`direction` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'not_queried' NOT NULL,
	`reason_code` text,
	`reason_note` text,
	`measure_code` text,
	`measure_note` text,
	`evidence_query_id` integer,
	`evidence_relation_id` integer,
	`moved_in_city` text,
	`moved_in_title_code` text,
	`moved_in_year` integer,
	`moved_in_batch` integer,
	`verification_status` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
	`recorded_at` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`enterprise_id`) REFERENCES `enterprise`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`title_code`) REFERENCES `title`(`code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`evidence_query_id`) REFERENCES `platform_query`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`evidence_relation_id`) REFERENCES `platform_relation`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`moved_in_title_code`) REFERENCES `title`(`code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

enterprise_alias.schema:
CREATE TABLE `enterprise_alias` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`enterprise_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`name_norm` text NOT NULL,
	`source_kind` text NOT NULL,
	`source_ref_id` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`valid_from` text,
	`valid_to` text,
	`verification_status` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
	`note` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`enterprise_id`) REFERENCES `enterprise`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

import_batch.schema:
CREATE TABLE `import_batch` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`idempotency_key` text NOT NULL,
	`source_kind` text NOT NULL,
	`source_identity` text NOT NULL,
	`source_sha256` text,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'preflight' NOT NULL,
	`preflight_result` text,
	`item_results` text,
	`summary` text,
	`error` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`committed_at` text
)

platform_export_batch.schema:
CREATE TABLE `platform_export_batch` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`title_code` text NOT NULL,
	`year` integer NOT NULL,
	`collected_on` text NOT NULL,
	`original_filename` text NOT NULL,
	`sha256` text NOT NULL,
	`row_count` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`import_status` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
	`source_document_id` integer,
	`import_batch_id` integer,
	`replaced_batch_id` integer,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`title_code`) REFERENCES `title`(`code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`source_document_id`) REFERENCES `source_document`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`import_batch_id`) REFERENCES `import_batch`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`replaced_batch_id`) REFERENCES `platform_export_batch`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

platform_export_row.schema:
CREATE TABLE `platform_export_row` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`batch_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`source_row_no` integer NOT NULL,
	`uscc_raw` text,
	`name_raw` text,
	`district` text,
	`province` text,
	`city` text,
	`reg_status` text,
	`raw_fields` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`batch_id`) REFERENCES `platform_export_batch`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
)

platform_query.schema:
CREATE TABLE `platform_query` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`interface` text NOT NULL,
	`query_key` text NOT NULL,
	`rdjb` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`title_code` text,
	`queried_at` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'not_queried' NOT NULL,
	`failure_reason` text,
	`raw_response` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL, `collection_evidence` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`title_code`) REFERENCES `title`(`code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

platform_relation.schema:
CREATE TABLE `platform_relation` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`query_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`sequence_no` integer NOT NULL,
	`relation_key` text,
	`enterprise_id` integer,
	`raw_fields` text,
	`source_text` text,
	`uscc_raw` text,
	`name_raw` text,
	`alias_name_raw` text,
	`province` text,
	`status` text,
	`batch` text,
	`declare_kind` text,
	`applied_at` text,
	`award_batch_label` text,
	`year` integer,
	`match_basis` text DEFAULT 'none' NOT NULL,
	`verification_status` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`query_id`) REFERENCES `platform_query`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`enterprise_id`) REFERENCES `enterprise`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

stored_file_audit.schema:
CREATE TABLE `stored_file_audit` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`stored_file_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`old_display_name` text NOT NULL,
	`new_display_name` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`stored_file_id`) REFERENCES `stored_file`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

service_credential.schema:
CREATE TABLE `service_credential` (
	`key` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`value` text NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` text NOT NULL
)

record_correspondence.schema:
CREATE TABLE `record_correspondence` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`edge_key` text NOT NULL,
	`type` text NOT NULL,
	`role` text NOT NULL,
	`event_id` integer,
	`predecessor_event_id` integer,
	`relation_id` integer,
	`export_row_id` integer,
	`enterprise_id` integer,
	`title_code` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text NOT NULL,
	`revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`target_identity` text NOT NULL,
	`provenance` text NOT NULL,
	`source_fingerprint` text NOT NULL,
	`rule_id` text NOT NULL,
	`rule_version` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	`decided_at` text,
	`ended_at` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`event_id`) REFERENCES `record_event`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`predecessor_event_id`) REFERENCES `record_event`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`relation_id`) REFERENCES `platform_relation`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`export_row_id`) REFERENCES `platform_export_row`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`enterprise_id`) REFERENCES `enterprise`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`title_code`) REFERENCES `title`(`code`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

record_correspondence_audit.schema:
CREATE TABLE `record_correspondence_audit` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`correspondence_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`batch_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`idempotency_key` text NOT NULL,
	`from_status` text,
	`to_status` text NOT NULL,
	`expected_revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`resulting_revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`actor_type` text NOT NULL,
	`actor_id` text NOT NULL,
	`basis` text NOT NULL,
	`rule_id` text NOT NULL,
	`rule_version` text NOT NULL,
	`evidence` text NOT NULL,
	`decided_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`correspondence_id`) REFERENCES `record_correspondence`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`batch_id`) REFERENCES `import_batch`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

comparison_scope_proof.schema:
CREATE TABLE `comparison_scope_proof` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`kind` text NOT NULL,
	`evidence` text NOT NULL,
	`source_fingerprint` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL
)

comparison_scope_proof_audit.schema:
CREATE TABLE `comparison_scope_proof_audit` (
	`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`proof_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`batch_id` integer NOT NULL,
	`idempotency_key` text NOT NULL,
	`from_status` text,
	`to_status` text NOT NULL,
	`expected_revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`resulting_revision` integer NOT NULL,
	`actor_type` text NOT NULL,
	`actor_id` text NOT NULL,
	`basis` text NOT NULL,
	`rule_id` text NOT NULL,
	`rule_version` text NOT NULL,
	`decided_at` text NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`proof_id`) REFERENCES `comparison_scope_proof`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`batch_id`) REFERENCES `import_batch`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)
